epics.title: Resolve Deployment Git Clone Timeout
epics.jtbd: When the automated launcher evaluates the repository, I want the product to clone and launch reliably within the time budget, so that health checks can complete and stakeholders can review the running system.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce launcher git clone timeouts from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The repository must be configured such that the launcher can clone and start it without hanging for more than 120 seconds.

slices.title: Diagnose and fix Git clone timeout in deployment configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to identify and resolve the root cause of the Git clone timeout, so that the deployed application launches successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh automated deployment environment,
When the launcher executes the clone command,
Then it completes successfully within the timeout.
Given the system is launched,
When the orchestrator checks its health,
Then the product reports as healthy.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease deployment phase timeout failure rate to 0%
